transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I... I don't know. My mom brought me. I just... I can't really do anything anymore. I just sit in my room. I don't... I don't change my clothes or anything. I used to knit and journal, but... I just don't. When she asks me what's wrong, I just... I don't even have the energy to talk to her.
Have you ever felt this way for a long period of time at any point in the past, or is this the first time you've felt like this?
I don't think so. I mean... I don't remember feeling like this before. It's just... now.
Do you ever hear or see things that other people around you cannot hear or see?
No... I don't think so. I don't really... no.
How long have you been feeling this way?
I guess... since I started community college. That was... maybe two years and a couple of months ago. I don't really... yeah. Since then.
During these past two years, have there been any periods where you felt unusually energetic, talkative, or impulsive, to the point where you didn't need much sleep?
No... I don't think so. I'm not really... energetic. I don't think I get like that.
Are you able to continue going to your classes or perform your daily responsibilities, even if it is very difficult?

No... not really. I had to... stop my certificate program. I just couldn't handle the practicum part. And... the clinic office job I was working toward... I can't really plan for that anymore. So... no.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or the amount of food you eat since you started feeling this way?
No... I don't really think about it. I just... eat normal, I guess. Nothing's really changed with that.
During these past two years, would you say that you have felt depressed or down most of the day, more days than not?
Um... no. I don't really think so. I don't feel sad or... down, really. Just... kind of the same most days, I guess. I don't know.
Have you been told by a doctor that you have any physical health problems, or have you had any recent head injuries or changes in your health that started around the same time as these feelings?
Um... no. I haven't... hit my head or anything. I don't have any physical problems that I know of. So... no.
Do you often feel like people are watching you, or do you feel like you have special or unusual beliefs that other people don't seem to understand or share?

I mean... I don't know if they're special beliefs. It's just... what I see happening. When I was taking those college classes, I noticed things. The school portal... and the people from the clinic practicum. They would change little words in the emails they sent me, or in the comments on my assignments. Just... tiny changes. But I know it was to mark me. To show they don't want me in healthcare. My mom says they're just normal messages, but... she doesn't see it. I just know what they're doing.
When you are at home, do you find that your thoughts become jumbled, or that you have trouble keeping track of what you are doing or saying?
Um... no. I don't think so. My thoughts are... they're just normal, I guess. I don't really lose track of what I'm doing.

Aside from your concerns about the emails and the people from your program, do you find that you have trouble showing emotions, or do you feel like you have lost the ability to enjoy things you once liked?

I don't know about showing emotions. I just... I don't really do much anymore. I mostly just stay in my room. I don't even change my clothes most days. I used to knit... and write in my journal. I liked going for walks. But I just... can't make myself do any of that now. When my mom asks me about it, I just... I don't really have the energy to even answer her.
When you are speaking to your mother or others, have they ever told you that your sentences don't make sense or that your words are jumbled together?
Um... no. I don't think so. She hasn't said anything like that. We don't really talk much anyway.
Have you ever been told by others that your behavior, such as your dress, your mannerisms, or the way you interact with people, seems strange, peculiar, or eccentric?
No. I mean... people don't really say much to me. Like I said, I just stay in my room. So... I don't know.
Have you ever considered the possibility that your interpretation of those emails might be incorrect, or are you absolutely certain that those people were intentionally trying to mark you?

I'm... I'm certain. I know what I saw. Ever since those college classes... the school portal, the clinic practicum people... they use these little wording changes. In the emails. In the assignment comments. It's... it's to mark me. To show they don't want me in healthcare. My mom says they're just regular messages, but... she doesn't see it. I know what they're doing.

Looking back over the past two years, have you consistently felt like you have had very little motivation to do things or felt like you have had very little to say to others, even when you weren't feeling particularly down?

Um... yeah, I guess. I just... I don't really do much anymore. I just sit in my room. Sometimes I don't even change my clothes. I used to... I don't know, knit, or write in my journal, or go for walks. But I just can't make myself do any of it now. And when my mom tries to talk to me about it, asks what's wrong... I just don't even have the energy to say anything back. So I just... don't.
